description: Game members TradeShuttlePlanner binds to. Most of this mod compiles against the public API, so a rename would be a build error. The exception is TradeSystem.SimulateTradeShuttlePreviewExchange, which is private and reached by reflection: if it is renamed or its signature moves, the mod silently degrades to value-only output with no error anywhere. That single member is the main reason this file exists. The rest are members whose meaning - not just their existence - the mod's arithmetic depends on.

methods.name: SimulateTradeShuttlePreviewExchange
methods.why: PRIVATE, reached by reflection. The only entry point that returns the resulting cargo list rather than just its total value, which is what lets the mod name the items coming back. Renaming it degrades the mod silently.

methods.name: GetTradeShuttleCargoWorldPrice
methods.why: values both the outbound hold and the simulated return, exactly as the vanilla PROFIT readout does

methods.name: HasTradeShuttleAvailableStations
methods.why: skips orbits that will not trade with the player at all, before spending a simulation on them

methods.name: IsValidItem
methods.why: the gate deciding whether a station consumes an item; drives the dead-weight report

methods.name: GetItemBuyPrice
methods.why: price at the player's current reputation, for the where-to-buy sweep and its ratio ranking

methods.name: GetTradeShuttleAvailableStations
methods.why: not called, but Planner.IsShuttleEligible reimplements its filter (CanBeTraded, the reputation floor, the contraband bypass, and the Barter-mode proxy-corp exclusion). If this drifts, the dead-weight report drifts with it.

fields.name: ShuttleInMove
fields.why: refuses to plan while the shuttle is already out

fields.name: Mode
fields.why: read, not written; the scan follows the player's chosen mode and only sweeps categories in Barter

fields.name: SelectedBarterCategoryId
fields.why: set to the category containing the wanted item, so the priority budget chases it

methods.name: CheckShuttleArrived
methods.why: called after unloading, exactly as the vanilla unload-all button does

properties.name: TradeMinReputationToExchange
properties.why: the reputation floor mirrored in IsShuttleEligible

properties.name: TradeShuttleBarterPriorityPercent
properties.why: not read in code, but the 60% figure the report's explanatory text quotes

fields.name: SpaceObjectId
fields.why: groups stations into the orbits the shuttle can be sent to

fields.name: OwnerFactionId
fields.why: resolves the faction whose reputation and prices apply

fields.name: InternalStorage
fields.why: the sale stock swept by the where-to-buy report

properties.name: CanBeTraded
properties.why: first term of the station eligibility filter

properties.name: TradeShuttleUnsupportedSellValuePercent
properties.why: the junk rate; ranks cargo the destination will not consume far below cargo it will

properties.name: ProxyFactionId
properties.why: Barter mode refuses to deal with the player's own proxy corporation, so its stations must not count as buyers

fields.name: CurrentSpaceObject
fields.why: the shuttle cannot be sent to the orbit it is already in

properties.name: InventoryWidthSize
properties.why: cell usage in the hold summary

properties.name: StackCount
properties.why: quantities in the returning-items and dead-weight lists

properties.name: ItemClasses
properties.why: maps an item's class to the dropdown option that would prioritise it

methods.name: Configure
methods.why: HARMONY POSTFIX. The stock market item window; its itemId argument is how the mod learns what the player is shopping for. A rename makes the mod forget the target entirely and it becomes unusable.

methods.name: RefreshView
methods.why: the hold is changed underneath the open screen, so it has to be told to redraw

fields.name: ShipCargo
fields.why: the source the shuttle is auto-loaded from

methods.name: AddCargo
methods.why: returns trial loadouts to ship cargo between candidate destinations

methods.name: IsQuestItem
methods.why: quest items must never be loaded; the vanilla screen blocks them too

methods.name: TryPutItem
methods.why: the actual load operation, same call the vanilla ctrl-click transfer uses

methods.name: Configure
methods.why: the in-game summary popup; a single TMP caption, which is why the full report goes to a file
